gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-np-hmong: Dark and spiky, Eater spaces its letters wide and keeps its ascenders stubby. Noto Serif NP Hmong comes in softer, a text serif with a charcoal-smudge shadow, and its lowercase climbs nearly to cap height.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-old-uyghur: Eater's thin strokes have no hairlines at all, and every gap between letters feels stretched wide. Noto Serif Old Uyghur brings tall, bulb-shaped lowercase and a text serif's quiet thick-thin shift, which gives the pair its refined bite.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-oriya: Noto Serif Oriya carries a dignified classic serif voice, with curves slightly heavier than its joins and capitals barely taller than lowercase. Eater, dark and wide-spaced above it, supplies all the menace.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-sinhala: Eater opens the pair with thin strokes free of hairlines, wide gaps between letters and short ascenders that crouch low. But Noto Serif Sinhala steps in as a bookish text serif, tall in its letter band, with stroke weights that differ just enough to feel alive.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-telugu: Aggressive is the mood Eater sets, with wide-set letters and short ascenders. Noto Serif Telugu follows as a traditional text serif, its gentle stroke shift and tall lowercase reaching almost to the capitals.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-thai: Eater looks dark and menacing, its letters spaced wide and its ascenders kept short. But Noto Serif Thai is the real anchor, a bookish text serif whose bodies dominate the line and whose mellow stroke weights lend it authority.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-tibetan: Dark and aggressive, Eater thrives on wide letter gaps and thin strokes without a single hairline. And Noto Serif Tibetan is built for steady reading, a text serif with a subtle thickness shift and lowercase rising close to cap height.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-todhri: Noto Serif Todhri is a traditional text serif whose curves keep real weight even at their thinnest, with a sizable x-height. Next to Eater's wide-spaced menace, it feels like firm ground.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-toto: Heavy chalk-pressed lowercase gives Noto Serif Toto a dignified, hulking presence beside Eater's jagged, wide-spaced display letters. Dark menace sits up top while the text serif holds the lines below with quiet authority.
gen-eater-gf-noto-serif-vithkuqi: Eater arrives with hairline-free thin strokes, wide letter gaps and stubby ascenders, all of it dark and aggressive. Noto Serif Vithkuqi reads classic and editorial, its big round bowls keeping the serif text inviting.
